console.help:
Inspect and debug
  help                         Show help
  clear                        Clear logs
  status                       Session, phase, turn, prompt, cheat flag
  players                      Seat numbers, money, positions
  hand                         Your hand card IDs
  inspect [state|prompt|profile|engine]
  inspect player [seat]        Player and state counters
  cards [query]                Find card IDs / names / bands; first 100 results
  tiles                        Tile numbers
  auto off|bot|chaos|advanced   Change your autopilot
  act {"act":"roll"}            Send command JSON (normal game rules apply)

Cheats (debug builds only; play phase, no pending prompt)
  money <amount> [seat]        Set money, 0–100000000
  tp <tile> [seat]             Teleport without passing / landing effects
  give <card ID or name> [count] [seat]
  draw <count> [seat]          Draw from the deck
  state <key> <value> [seat]   Set an existing counter, honoring its cap;
                               inspect player lists the keys
  Examples: money 50000 / tp 10 / draw 2 / state fire 5

Seats start at 0; omitted seat means yourself. Quote names with spaces.
Count is 1–100. Cheats are saved and recorded, and set the cheated flag.
The game keeps running. ↑↓ history, Tab completes command names.
